Area.evidence_source: Most of the prisoners experienced at least one visual image whilst suicidal. Amongst the most common images were 'what might happen to other people if you died', 'yourself planning or preparing to harm yourself or make a suicide attempt' and 'what might happen to you if you died'. These findings may be especially problematic in the context of suicide, but tackling potentially modifiable imagery processes may be feasible in treatment, as it is in cognitive behavioural therapy (CBT) for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
